Three files in the repository contain the literal string `GracePeriodTime`, all under the OrderProcessor project:

1. **`src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs`** — twice: as a SQL parameter placeholder in the query `WHERE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - "OrderDate" >= @GracePeriodTime AND "OrderStatus" = 'Submitted'` (`src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:72`) and when binding that parameter, `command.Parameters.AddWithValue("GracePeriodTime", TimeSpan.FromMinutes(_options.GracePeriodTime))` (`src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:74`).
2. **`src/OrderProcessor/BackgroundTaskOptions.cs`** — the property declaration `public int GracePeriodTime { get; set; }` (`src/OrderProcessor/BackgroundTaskOptions.cs:5`).
3. **`src/OrderProcessor/appsettings.json`** — the configuration key `"GracePeriodTime": "1"` (`src/OrderProcessor/appsettings.json:15`).

I established this with a repository-wide regex search, then repeated it with ignore rules disabled and hidden files included (excluding only `.git/`), which returned the same three files — so no gitignored or hidden file contains the string.
